title: SmartProctoring identity accuracy baseline (internal smoke set)
dataset: Public deepface unit-test photos: the 25 images labelled in its master.csv (9 subjects, 38 same-person and 262 different-person pairs). Subjects anonymised (s01..s09); no image or file names are stored here. Capture-condition tags were assigned by visible attributes only.
caveat: Tiny smoke set of adult celebrity portraits. It cannot establish error rates for production; see docs/accuracy/identity.md for the dataset protocol customers must run on consented data.

notes: Genuine trials: each non-reference image vs its own subject reference. Impostor trials: every image vs every other subject reference.
Condition groups come from the file-name tags; a probe with several tags counts in each of them.

notes: Each pair enrols one image as a single-image reference (file_x, or file_y if file_x fails the quality gate; pairs where neither passes are enrolment failures) and probes with the other.

thresholdStudy.description: Same runs with match threshold 0.45 (mismatch 0.28 unchanged). Compact per-group outcome rates.

eventAssumption: Consecutive samples are treated as independent draws from the per-sample outcome rates measured for this group. Real samples of one candidate are positively correlated (same room, camera, lighting), so the independent figures are optimistic for false alerts and the correlated bound is shown alongside. A follow-up sample is requested immediately after a mismatch, so a confirmed event needs 2 consecutive mismatches.
